title: PRIME — GROCERY STORE
lessons: The player encounters a retailer-exclusive PRIME Shake collaboration rather than the original hydration bottle.
The player already knows PRIME but sees unfamiliar packaging and checks the brand site to make sure the bottle is legitimate.

text: The player encounters a retailer-exclusive PRIME Shake collaboration rather than the original hydration bottle.

entry-first-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: Protein shake?

entry-first-2.speaker: PRIME
text: Surprise. I wanted another refrigerator shelf.

entry-first-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: Hydration was not enough territory?

entry-first-4.speaker: PRIME
text: Target got an exclusive PRIME Shake collaboration. Hydration got you into the brand. Shake asks whether you will follow me into another category.

choice-first.speaker: PRIME
text: What do you make of that?

choices.text: I respect how absurdly committed you are to expanding.
This feels like you are trying to become the whole aisle.
I wanted a drink, not a brand crossover universe.

first-1.speaker: PRIME
text: Thank you. Restraint has never tested well on me.

first-2.speaker: PRIME
text: Correct. I am expanding on purpose.

first-3.speaker: PRIME
text: Then buy the one thing you came for. I can handle a smaller cart.
The player already knows PRIME but sees unfamiliar packaging and checks the brand site to make sure the bottle is legitimate.

entry-return-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: Why does this bottle look wrong?

entry-return-2.speaker: PRIME
text: Check it before you drink it.

entry-return-3.speaker: PLAYER
text: You have a whole page for that?

entry-return-4.speaker: PRIME
text: Country, size, label, formula, flavors. The hype got big enough that fake or unauthorized product became a real problem.

choice-return.speaker: PRIME
text: What do you make of that?

choices.text: I like that I can verify it myself.
The fact that I need to verify a sports drink is wild.
If I have to investigate a bottle, I am buying something else.

return-1.speaker: PRIME
text: Good. Trust the list and trusted retailers, not a random bottle with my logo.

return-2.speaker: PRIME
text: I know. Needing a verification page is not a victory lap.

return-2-1.speaker: PLAYER
text: Finally, humility.

return-2-2.speaker: PRIME
text: Do not get used to it.

return-3.speaker: PRIME
text: Reasonable. A sports drink should not require detective work.
